text:
[Council File 26-1641; CD 11]
Municipal Facilities Committee report relative to authorizing the General Services Department to negotiate and execute a no-cost, revocable license agreement with Palisades Village Co., LLC for the installation and operation of Los Angeles Police Department drone-related equipment on rooftop space located at 15279 Sunset Boulevard.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes

None submitted
